rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for “nobody” or “no one.”
Use this when referring to no particular person among the people being considered.

example.english: nobody knows how to make this dish
example.jyutping: mou5 bin1 go3 sik1 zing2 ni1 mei6 sung3

rows.note: Use this emphatic phrase when stressing that not even one person is involved or present.

example.english: There is nobody in the restaurant
example.jyutping: caan1 teng1 jap6 min6 jat1 go3 jan4 dou1 mou5
